messages:
Maya (Product): Quick design review — the new connection checks step in Private onboarding. A few accessibility and copy nits I noticed when testing on a narrow viewport. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/s/conn-checks
Oliver (Design): Looks good overall. Quick notes: the status pills have only a 2.8:1 contrast vs BG — needs stronger tint or a border. Also the primary button on failed probes reads 'Retry' but visually it's the heaviest action, feels like it competes with 'Continue'.
Sam (Engineering): Agree on contrast. For the button hierarchy, maybe primary should be 'Continue setup' and retry is secondary/tertiary. Also keyboard users don't see the ephemeral toast when probes finish — we should add an aria-live region or move focus briefly to the summary.
Jordan (Accessibility): Yes, add a role="status" container with aria-live="polite" for probe updates. Ensure we don't steal focus unexpectedly; instead make the summary focusable and announce changes so screen readers pick it up.
Priya (PM): Copy suggestion for unreachable hosts: current: 'Your host isn't reachable' -> proposed: 'Unable to reach host. Check firewall, routing, or VPC peering.' Shorter help link: 'Troubleshoot host reachability' (links to KB).
Oliver (Design): Also microcopy for ports: avoid terse 'Port 22 fail' — prefer 'SSH (port 22) blocked — required to connect to host'. Keep tone action-oriented.
Maya (Product): Mobile / narrow layout problem: the three-column status table wraps badly and hides the action buttons. Proposal: collapse rows into a compact stepper on small widths — icon + short status + chevron to expand details.
Sam (Engineering): CSS idea for compact rows: ```.status-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; } .status-row .detail { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }``` That keeps the action on the right without wrapping text.
Priya (PM): Edge case: when a probe is skipped (user chose SSH-only or opted out), we show a grey 'Skipped' pill. Add a tooltip: 'Skipped because this check isn't required for your configuration.' Also surface the reason in the expanded detail.
Jordan (Accessibility): Keyboard: make each row focusable (tabindex=0) and support Enter/Space to toggle details; set aria-expanded and manage focus to the detail region when opened. Ensure skip/expand buttons have clear labels for screen readers.
Maya (Product): Great — can @Oliver and @Priya prototype the revised copy + pill colors in Figma? I'll update the acceptance criteria for the ticket: 1) color contrast >= 4.5:1 for status text, 2) aria-live status for probe updates, 3) keyboard-expand rows with aria-expanded, 4) concise, actionable help links. Post the Figma link here once ready.
deploy-bot: Reminder: design critique at 15:00 in #product — bring the prototype :bell:
Oliver (Design): Will do. I'll push a variant that keeps the 'Retry' action tertiary and adds an inline help link. Expect a Figma link in ~2 hours.
Sam (Engineering): I'll add a tiny accessibility test to the e2e step that asserts the summary announces on probe completion.
Maya (Product): Thanks all. If anyone sees other microcopy that reads as too technical for first-time users, flag it here and we'll pare it back.
